snippet.title: "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil" 1st Trailer—Releasing September10
snippet.description:
The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.
A vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up where shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa resolve the incident.
Nintendo Switch™, Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation®5, and Steam release Thursday, September 10, 2026!

The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.
You can also play the Classic version, which recreates the original 2002 gameplay as closely as possible.

■Official Website
https://touhou-project.news/shanghai-alice-reprise/
